I'm often in the dilemma that I have Kodi and I don't want to scrape the download folder for obvious reasons (would've to permanently clean the database and re-scan all the time, etc).

But when I wanna watch something that I'm still downloading, I have to watch the file, and hence it's not properly marked was watched and synced to my trakt.

And I don't want to copy it to my movie/series folder, because it would take a lot of basically 'dead' storage.

So how do you manage it if you seed stuff for a long time but also use a media center?
How do you store still seeding downloads?
Would you be able to save them to the correct place before you start downloading it? That way you aren't making copies of it, and you're still getting them to the right folders.

Yeah, that's another option, but then you'd have your downloads/seeds all over the place instead of collecting them in one place..

But yeah, that'd be another option

I use ZFS with deduplication. 2 copies of the files, 1 time storage used. Has some performance requirements, but for my use case it is definitely worth it
Yeah, that's a fancy solution indeed... I thought about something like symbolic links, but somehow it always ended up being more effort than worth

Its a pretty good solution, I'm only doing music and I end up with something like this (note the 1.65x deduplication). Not all data is duplicated, so I definitely find it worth using.
